behavior: When `KeepAlive` deactivates a trigger, the trigger stops its open delay. A popup that focus opened and that the trigger anchors then closes with the reason `trigger-focus`. This is the exception to the open state that a popup keeps under `KeepAlive`. The focused trigger leaves the document, and Firefox and WebKit send no `focusout` for it, so the popup would stay open after the activation with no focus on its trigger. Base UI has no counterpart of `KeepAlive`.
